description.text: Most of the majors for PhD could be taught in English. Doctor students could choose their major to be taught in Chinese or English language based on their own situation, and their degree dissertation could be chosen to be written in Chinese or English. Note: This course can be taught in Chinese, and the tuition is 30,000RMB/ year.

duration.text: The Logistic Technology and Equipment at Wuhan University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7. Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have master degree.
